race.comment: THE VICTORIOUS (4) was comfortably accounted for when second last time out over 2050m at Murtoa, beaten 5 lengths. That followed a win at Geelong at the previous outing and he looks nicely placed to play a pivotal role. LOVE SPARKLES (3) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 3 lengths when fifth over 2100m at Ballarat Synthetic a month ago after being prominent at the turn. Perfectly placed and is sure to give this a mighty shake. FONN POWER (1) drifted well back last start then wound up strongly to finish fourth over 2050m at Murtoa. Can feature in the finish. ABERLUTELY (8) ran her best race of the prep last start when back in grade. Stays in similar grade this time and looks a key player. FLIGHT DECK (13) has a horrible winning strike rate, but is a regular among the placings, most recently last time out.
